t: This is Grosvenor Gardens, two triangular parks in Belgravia, with a street of the same name along their western and eastern sides. The roads run roughly north to south, from Hobart Place and Grosvenor Place down to Buckingham Palace Road. Sir Benjamin Samuel Faudel-Phillips, the second baronet, lived here. He was born in 1871 and died in 1927. That is all the material tells me about him, so I will leave it there and let you enjoy the gardens.
